deals.travelWindow: Sep-Dec 2026, cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on United
deals.whyRanked: The cheapest verified fare of the five at $141 RT nonstop — down from $152 a few days ago — and Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor is 90 minutes from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: LoDo and RiNo are compact and walkable with counter-seating breweries, and the A Line train removes any need for a rideshare from the airport.

highlights: Larimer Square's historic block and rooftop bars
Denver Botanic Gardens
Cherry Creek bike path along the river
RiNo Art District murals and breweries
Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor
itinerary: Day 1 — Larimer Square in the afternoon, dinner and a brewery crawl through LoDo.
Day 2 — Denver Botanic Gardens in the morning, Cherry Creek bike path in the afternoon, RiNo for dinner.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Rocky Mountain NP: the Bear Lake corridor for an easy alpine hike, back to Denver for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The A Line train covers the airport-to-downtown hop and LoDo/RiNo are walkable; a rental car is needed for the national park.
guide.stayArea: LoDo or Capitol Hill — walkable to Larimer Square and the train.

deals.travelWindow: Sep - early Dec 2026, cheapest confirmed one-stop fares on American
deals.whyRanked: $228 RT with one stop, and Channel Islands National Park's boats depart from nearby Ventura Harbor, while Santa Barbara's flat, palm-lined State Street is built for walking alone.
deals.soloWhy: State Street and the waterfront are flat, safe, and walkable end to end, and the Funk Zone's tasting rooms are built around solo counter seating.

highlights: Old Mission Santa Barbara
State Street shopping and people-watching
Funk Zone wine tasting rooms
Stearns Wharf at sunset
Channel Islands National Park boat trip to Anacapa Island
itinerary: Day 1 — Old Mission Santa Barbara, State Street in the afternoon, dinner in the Funk Zone.
Day 2 — Funk Zone wine tasting, Stearns Wharf and East Beach at sunset.
Day 3 — Drive to Ventura Harbor for the Island Packers boat to Channel Islands National Park, back for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and the waterfront are entirely walkable, with a free electric shuttle along State Street; a rental car is needed for the Ventura Harbor boat dock.
guide.stayArea: The Funk Zone or downtown near State Street — walkable to the wharf and tasting rooms.
food: Santa Barbara Shellfish Company (on the wharf)

deals.travelWindow: Fall 2026, cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on United
deals.whyRanked: $240 RT nonstop, and Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area is a 20-minute drive from the Strip, with Zion National Park reachable in 2.5 hours for a longer day trip.

nearbyParks.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area

deals.soloWhy: The Strip's monorail and pedestrian bridges make it easy to get around without a car, though the scene skews toward groups more than solo travelers.

highlights: The Strip: Bellagio Fountains and the Venetian canals
Fremont Street Experience downtown
Seven Magic Mountains art installation
Red Rock Canyon's 13-mile scenic loop drive
Zion National Park day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk the Strip from Bellagio to the Venetian, Fremont Street Experience at night.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Seven Magic Mountains and the Red Rock Canyon scenic loop with a short trailhead hike.
Day 3 — Drive to Zion National Park for a canyon hike (Riverside Walk or Angels Landing permitting) before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The Strip monorail and pedestrian bridges cover the casino corridor; a rental car is essential for Red Rock Canyon and Zion.
guide.stayArea: Mid-Strip near Bellagio or Aria — walkable to the monorail and Fountains.

deals.travelWindow: Mid-Aug through early Dec 2026, cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: $257 RT nonstop, and Joshua Tree National Park is a 3-hour drive from a city where Griffith Park and the Metro rail make solo exploring easy.
deals.soloWhy: Silver Lake and Venice are walkable, counter-seating-friendly neighborhoods, and the Metro's B and E lines cover Hollywood and the beach without a rideshare.

highlights: Griffith Observatory and the Griffith Park trails
Venice Beach boardwalk and Abbot Kinney Boulevard
The Getty Center
Silver Lake reservoir loop
Joshua Tree National Park day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Griffith Park hike to the Observatory for sunset views over the city.
Day 2 — Venice Beach boardwalk in the morning, Abbot Kinney shops and dinner in the evening.
Day 3 — Drive to Joshua Tree National Park for the Hidden Valley trail before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The Metro B and E lines cover Hollywood, Downtown, and Santa Monica; a rental car is needed for Griffith Park's upper trails and Joshua Tree.
guide.stayArea: Silver Lake or Santa Monica — walkable, close to a Metro stop.

deals.travelWindow: Fall 2026, cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: The priciest of the five at $297 RT nonstop, but Mount Rainier and Olympic National Parks are both within 2 hours of one of the most walkable, transit-friendly downtowns in the country.
deals.soloWhy: Pike Place Market and Capitol Hill are dense, walkable, and full of counter-seating spots, and the light rail runs straight from the airport into downtown.

highlights: Pike Place Market and the waterfront
Kerry Park skyline viewpoint
Chihuly Garden and Glass
Ballard Locks and the Ballard farmers market
Mount Rainier National Park day hike
itinerary: Day 1 — Pike Place Market in the morning, waterfront walk, dinner in Belltown.
Day 2 — Capitol Hill in the morning, Kerry Park for sunset, Chihuly Garden and Glass at night.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Mount Rainier National Park: the Skyline Trail from Paradise before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Link light rail covers the airport-to-downtown hop, and Capitol Hill and Belltown are walkable; a rental car is needed for Mount Rainier or Olympic National Park.
guide.stayArea: Capitol Hill or Belltown — walkable to Pike Place and the light rail.
